title: Music longer than the edit stops where the picture stops
goal: Put a three minute song under a ninety second cut and the whole edit becomes three minutes long: the title bar, the timeline and the Export sheet all say 2:59, and the exported MP4 is ninety seconds of talk followed by ninety seconds of song over a blank picture. Nothing on screen points this out. A music bed is in the focus workflow, and a person who has just cut to ninety seconds expects ninety seconds out. This task makes a song that runs past the last picture behave the way the user picks on the card.
notes: Reproduced 2026-10-08 by the manager: /tmp/mgr-walks2/music-bed.json (the-ninety-second-cut-walk steps, then importPicks a 180 s m4a made with ffmpeg sine, Sequence > Add Media at Playhead at 0:00). Result: step 62 expectTimeline: the timeline runs 179975ms, not 90000ms. Pictures: queue/manager/shots/2026-10-08-0640-music-past-the-cut.png (title bar Long Talk Retina 2880 x 1800 2:59, Song on Audio 2 to 3:00, V1 ends at 1:30) and queue/manager/shots/2026-10-08-0640-export-says-2-59.png (sheet line 2880 x 1800 px 30 fps 2:59). Code: EditorState+Audio.swift addSound(from:atMS:) lands the whole sound; the document length is the latest end of any layer. Premiere does the same (sequence runs to the end of the longest track); iMovie and Clips trim background music to the movie. Related but separate: music-dips-under-the-speech-by-itself (ducking, its own card).
acceptance: Built as the decision card answer says, at Next defaults with no switch

A walk (music-bed-under-a-cut-walk or similar) opens the five minute talk, cuts it to ninety seconds as the-ninety-second-cut-walk does, adds a sound longer than the edit with Sequence > Add Media at Playhead at 0:00, and checks the timeline length and the Export sheet say what the answer promises; it also drops the sound on the timeline by dragging and gets the same result
A sound shorter than the edit, and a sound added on its own with no picture at all, behave exactly as today
One Undo takes the landing back whole
Try: open any recording, cut it short, press Home, Sequence > Add Media at Playhead, pick a song longer than the cut, then open File > Export and read the length. Audit written under queue/audits/
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task log if it does not
